# Third-party historical market data

A publicly accessible GitHub repository contains a large historical AGMARKNET-derived dataset:

Repository:
https://github.com/BatMan0100/agricast

File:
agmarknet_india_historical_prices_2024_2025.csv

The repository describes the file as daily Agmarknet-scraped data for October 2024–August 2025,
with over 1.1 million rows and columns including district, market, commodity, variety, grade,
min_price, max_price, modal_price, price_date and state.

IMPORTANT:
- This is third-party redistributed data, not a direct official download.
- Preserve attribution and license information.
- Validate the records against authoritative data before production use.
- After download, place the file in this folder unchanged.
